items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring specific architectural milestones are met before parallel development begins.
The blocking infrastructure layer containing shared utilities and core logic required by all subsequent feature implementations.
The primary functional objective a user must achieve within a specific feature set.
A unique alphanumeric token used to track individual work units or distinguish stored entities.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent storage and scriptable output.
The minimal set of functional capabilities required to provide basic value to the end user.
The structural grouping of work units by user story to ensure independent implementability.
The set of mandatory design documents and specifications required before implementation starts.
The primary documentation file detailing usage and storage behavior.
The initial phase focused on package skeleton creation and tooling configuration.
The specific work unit responsible for handling empty collection states with user-facing notifications.
The verification layer consisting of unit and integration directory structures.
The process of assigning a timestamp to the creation field of a new entity.
The operation that purges all entities marked as finished from the persistent store.
The operation that retrieves and displays all stored entities in a readable or machine-parseable format.
A high-priority constraint indicating a hard dependency that blocks all subsequent development.
